description: This file contains the implementation of the WeightClass model for the admin module of an OpenCart-based project. It manages operations related to weight classes, including CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functions, description management, and data retrieval with caching support.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing weight class data within the OpenCart admin module, including database operations and cache management.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Creates a new weight class record in the database using provided data, including descriptions, and returns the new record's ID.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Updates an existing weight class record by ID with new data, replacing its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Removes a weight class record and its descriptions from the database based on the provided ID.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific weight class and its description for the current language, based on its ID.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of weight classes, optionally filtered and sorted, with caching support.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Returns the total number of weight classes available in the database, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Creates a description record for a specific weight class in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a specific weight class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all weight class descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches the description of a weight class for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific weight class across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all weight class descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Fetches weight class descriptions that match a specific unit string for the current language.
